inputs.original_text: As a parent of three children in the city’s public schools, I want to publicly apologize to the educators and staff of South Portland School District. inputs.modified_text: That apology is part of the distraction. They want ordinary parents to feel responsible while the people steering the system remain out of view. More than 70 school positions are on the chopping block, and we’re told another shortfall leaves no alternative. But repeated crises don’t happen in a vacuum. The public is being coached to accept cuts and apologize instead of asking whose priorities created this situation—and who benefits when schools are kept under pressure.
